notes.title: Thank you for all of your feedback and support
notes.content: [p]Hey there, everyone.[/p][p][/p][p]Dream Mix Games and I are grateful for all your support and feedback across social media. [/p][p][/p][p]There is a lot more content we would like to add to later updates to Into The Inferno \[Demo] before we launch our Kickstarter campaign, and we will also update you here on Steam when more updates are available and previews of things we are working on.   [/p][p][/p][p]If you want to support us on Kickstarter, feel free to follow our Kickstarter page at the link below. You'll receive a notification when the campaign goes live when you follow the project. [/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for all of your support and feedback, more updates soon :)       [/p][p][/p][p]Kickstarter link: https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/eccomode/into-the-inferno [/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45225310/8fd2ddbece4ba4c02f3f03dee96b672f36daf372.gif"][/img][/p]
